verdict.rationale: ADP's own docs say RUN calculates, files, and pays payroll taxes for you (adp-run-docs-1). They add that RUN handles tax filing for employees working across multiple state or local jurisdictions (adp-run-docs-19), backed by a guarantee to cover penalties from ADP filing errors (adp-run-docs-15), plus SUI management (adp-run-docs-21). No community or hands-on evidence speaks to tax filing either way. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of federal/state/local filing and remittance mechanics (the evidence is marketing-level), independent or hands-on corroboration of the automated tax filing.
